title: Tomato and Vegetable Juice 100%, Low Sodium

content.title: About
content.content: Tomato and vegetable juice 100% is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from ripe tomatoes and a blend of vegetables (carrot, celery, pepper). The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives or flavorings and has a reduced sodium content (≈30 mg per 100 ml), making it suitable for people watching their salt intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tomato juice is rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that gives it a bright red color.
Vegetable juice is often used as a base for soups, sauces and marinades.
Low sodium is achieved by selecting vegetables naturally low in salt and minimizing added salt during production.
Tomato juice is a good alternative to sugary soft drinks because it contains no sugar or artificial sweeteners.
In many markets the product is sold in glass bottles, which helps preserve flavor and aroma.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Lycopene helps protect cells from oxidative stress and supports heart health.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains vitamin A and beta‑carotene
items.content: These compounds support vision and skin health.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: Suitable for low‑salt diets and helps maintain healthy blood pressure.

items.title: Hydration and electrolytes
items.content: The juice provides potassium, important for fluid balance.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes or other vegetables in the blend.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The high acidity can cause heartburn in people sensitive to acidic foods.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Although low, people on strict sodium restriction should account for total daily intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled as a refreshing beverage, add it to smoothies, cocktails, or use it as a base for cold soups (gazpacho) and sauces. A squeeze of lemon or fresh herbs can enhance the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 2–6 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours to prevent microbial growth.
